dimensions.assessment: Directly affects Department of State personnel, diplomatic missions, and interactions with United Nations entities and Congress.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be a United States Mission to the United Nations

dimensions.assessment: Restructures major diplomatic and operational units, UN representation protocols, and internal reporting mandates.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall establish a Red Team Capability to inform the Department's crisis response

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes the Secretary to receive and allocate appropriated funds for fiscal years 2026 and 2027 and mandates reports on unfunded priorities.
dimensions.evidence: receive all the funds appropriated to the Department and allocate such funds to fulfill missions and responsibilities for fiscal year 2026 and 2027

dimensions.assessment: Sweeps across the organization of the entire Department of State, formalizing leadership roles, legal advisers, intelligence and legislative bureaus, and UN policies.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent organizational structures for the Department of State with budgetary allocations for fiscal years 2026 and 2027.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill provides comprehensive authorities for the Secretary of State, organizes the Office of the Secretary, establishes statutory frameworks for the U.S. Ambassador and Mission to the UN, creates multiple bureaus and offices, and institutes a Red Team Capability.
